motion.name: dash
motion.purpose: The tab stroke slides to the open room; the room enters 40px from the side of travel with a 4px blur.

motion.purpose: The stamp presses in once per finished job, scale 1.35 to 1.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action that matters in a region.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 36px; padding: 7px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--control, #8a8696); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--card, #fff); color: var(--ink, #1c1a21); font: 600 14px/20px system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary { border-color: var(--violet, #4f2a9a); background: var(--violet, #4f2a9a); color: var(--violet-ink, #fff); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--violet, #4f2a9a) 86%, var(--ink, #1c1a21)); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--violet, #4f2a9a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Button
components.css: .ds-btn-default { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 36px; padding: 7px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--control, #8a8696); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--card, #fff); color: var(--ink, #1c1a21); font: 600 14px/20px system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-default:hover { border-color: var(--ink, #1c1a21); } .ds-btn-default:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--violet, #4f2a9a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { min-height: 36px; padding: 7px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--red, #c8322b); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--card, #fff); color: var(--red, #c8322b); font: 600 14px/20px system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: var(--red, #c8322b); color: var(--card, #fff); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--violet, #4f2a9a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Room Tab
components.description: A numbered drawer tab; the open one has a filled key and the dash under it.
components.css: .ds-tab { position: relative; display: inline-grid; grid-template-columns: auto auto; column-gap: 10px; padding: 12px 14px; color: var(--ink, #1c1a21); font: 14px/1.25 system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-tab kbd { grid-row: span 2; align-self: center; padding: 0 5px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #b9b5c4); border-radius: 5px; font: 600 12px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tab small { color: var(--muted, #5d5a66); font-size: 12px; } .ds-tab[aria-current='page'] span { font-weight: 750; } .ds-tab[aria-current='page'] kbd { border-color: var(--violet, #4f2a9a); background: var(--violet, #4f2a9a); color: var(--violet-ink, #fff); } .ds-tab[aria-current='page']::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 3px; background: var(--violet, #4f2a9a); } .ds-tab:hover span { color: var(--violet, #4f2a9a); }

components.name: Book Card
components.description: One book on the shelf; a coverless book shows a ruled catalogue card.
components.css: .ds-card { display: grid; gap: 8px; width: 180px; padding: 10px 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #dcd9e2); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--card, #fff); color: var(--ink, #1c1a21); font: 14px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card span { color: var(--muted, #5d5a66); } .ds-cover { display: grid; place-items: center; aspect-ratio: 2 / 3; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--violet-wash, #efeaf9); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 8px var(--violet-wash, #efeaf9), inset 0 0 0 9px var(--violet, #4f2a9a); color: var(--violet, #4f2a9a); font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Text fields and selects share the button's box.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="From the file name if empty">
components.css: .ds-input { min-height: 36px; padding: 7px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--control, #8a8696); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--card, #fff); color: var(--ink, #1c1a21); font: 14px/20px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #5d5a66); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--violet, #4f2a9a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Stamp
components.description: The Copista stamp, pressed once per finished conversion.
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-grid; justify-items: center; gap: 2px; margin: 12px; padding: 10px 18px 8px; border: 3px solid var(--violet, #4f2a9a); border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--card, #fff), inset 0 0 0 3px var(--violet, #4f2a9a); color: var(--violet, #4f2a9a); font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; transform: rotate(-6deg); } .ds-stamp-label { padding-left: 0.14em; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-stamp-note { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Ticket
components.description: The Scriptorium's From / To / Done container with dashed perforations.
components.css: .ds-ticket { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.25fr 1fr; width: 520px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #b9b5c4); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--card, #fff); color: var(--ink, #1c1a21); font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-ticket section { padding: 20px 24px 32px; } .ds-ticket section + section { border-left: 1px dashed var(--line-strong, #b9b5c4); } .ds-ticket h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; }

narrative.northStar: The Card Catalogue and the Date Stamp
narrative.overview:
Copista is a set of four drawers. Each room is reached in one keystroke (1 to 4) or one tap, does one kind of job, and every finished conversion gets the Copista stamp: a violet, slightly tilted, double-ruled rectangle. The same stamp is the brand mark in the top bar and the app icon, so the thing you see when a job is done is the thing you recognise the app by.

The surface is an operating tool, not a showcase. Paper ground, white cards, ink text, thin rules. Nothing on screen is ornamental unless it marks state: the open room, the one action that matters, or a finished job. The look stays quiet so people can move around fast.
keyCharacteristics: One accent colour, violet, reserved for state and the primary action.
One authored move between rooms, the dash; one authored mark for finished work, the stamp.
Each room has its own interior: a shelf of book cards, a reader that hides its chrome, a three-part ticket, a ruled ledger.
Phones get the room tabs in a bottom bar within thumb reach.

rules.name: The Stamp Ink Rule
rules.body: Violet means "this is where you are" or "do this" or "this is done". If an element is none of the three, it is not violet.

rules.name: The Red Ink Rule
rules.body: Red appears only for errors and for deleting. It never decorates.

rules.name: The Tabular Count Rule
rules.body: Counts, sizes and dates use tabular numerals so they line up in the ledger and on the stamp.

rules.name: The One Line Rule
rules.body: The Scriptorium reads left to right as one journey: what you have, what you want, what you got. Do not add a fourth leg or a side panel.

rules.name: The Flat Drawer Rule
rules.body: No drop shadows on cards, the ticket or menus. If something must stand out, give it a stronger rule or the violet wash.

dos: Do keep violet for the open room, the primary action, the dash and the stamp.
Do keep every room one keystroke or one tap away, and keep the bottom bar on phones.
Do press the stamp once per finished job and nowhere else.
Do give every motion a reduced-motion version with no movement.
Do use tabular numerals for counts, sizes and dates.
donts: Don't add drop shadows, gradients or glass effects; the system is flat paper and rules.
Don't use red for anything but errors and deleting.
Don't add a label above a heading; the room name speaks for itself.
Don't add a second authored animation between rooms; the dash is the only one.
Don't add ornament that does not mark state; the user asked for an uncluttered look.
